capabilities: share individual notes via generated links
include linked attachments and embedded media in shares
connect the plugin to a self-hosted sharing backend
authenticate to the server with an API key
extras: The plugin is unusable without deploying the separate backend via Docker, including mounting a settings.toml and configuring storage volume and port 8181; usage instructions are terse and include no example output.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to share a note with its linked attachments and embeds as a link without using Obsidian Publish.

requires.name: API key for the sharing server

summary: Sharing plugin that generates links to notes including their linked attachments and embedded images, backed by a self-hosted server.
